title: Diode 1N4148, small signal fast switching

sources.document: Vishay 1N4148 Small Signal Fast Switching Diodes, document 81857, Rev. 1.6, 07-Nov-2024

note: Datasheet: DO-35 glass case, black cathode band; reverse voltage 75 V (100 V repetitive peak); forward current 300 mA continuous. The datasheet numbers no pins: pin 1 anode and pin 2 cathode is the diode convention of this catalogue (diode.json), not the datasheet's.
